name: toolip-vscode
description: Local read-only Toolip diagnostics for trusted workspaces.

toolip.executablePath.description: Absolute, regular non-symlink Toolip executable outside all workspaces, configured at user scope. No automatic download.

toolip.enabled.description: Explicitly opt in, at user scope, to launching the configured local Toolip executable. Never set by a project.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: No Toolip process is launched for untrusted workspaces.
